pattern: Friday high < Thursday high; target-session low < Friday low (strict comparisons)

universe.limitation: Fixed current membership, not point-in-time historical constituents; survivorship bias. SPY is context only. Other stocks and leveraged ETFs excluded.

calendar: XNYS rule calendar v1, 2021–2027; 2025-01-09 extraordinary closure; literal Thursday and Friday required; Monday holiday substitutes Tuesday only, separate cohort; missing observations never imply holiday. Early closes included.
price_basis: Massive split-adjusted daily OHLC from completed operational collector snapshots; no dividend adjustment; never combine sources within an observation
baseline: All eligible same-symbol Thursday/Friday/target triplets, without lower-high filter, same window and cohort. Also report nonqualifying control rate. Missing outcomes excluded from denominator and counted.
excursions: Descriptive target-open-based short MFE=max(0,(open-low)/open)*100 and MAE=max(0,(high-open)/open)*100 across entire target session; no entry execution or P&L claim. Target open below Friday low is gap-through hit.
market_condition: Friday SPY close versus EMA20 using at least 20 consecutive exchange sessions through Friday; never target-day information. Unknown when incomplete.
origins: prospective only when first recorded after Friday close and before target open; historical otherwise. Historical records never relabeled prospective.
limitations: Pattern hit rate is not trade profitability.
Pooled symbol-weeks are correlated; no independent-trial significance claim.
Five-year target remains required; shorter results explicitly preliminary.
Fixed calendar horizon fails closed after 2027.
